key_insight: Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO) turns Policy Mirror Descent for terminal-reward RL into a trajectory-level objective, eliminating the need for intermediate state-value estimation while preserving the same unique optimum.
engineering_relevance: BPO offers a simpler, critic-free training recipe for reasoning-focused LLM reinforcement learning, which can reduce implementation complexity and instability in RLVR pipelines.
method: Reformulates PMD using Bellman equations at the trajectory level.
Derives a practical BPO loss by approximating the reformulated objective.
Uses a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities as a mismatch-correction weight.
evidence_signal: The paper reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, showing that BPO is effective for improving reasoning performance.
watch_item: The practical gain depends on the approximation quality of the derived loss, so the smoothed mismatch-correction weighting may be sensitive to training setup and reward design.
